description: This file is a shell script that provides utility functions for managing prplMesh services, including starting, stopping, restarting processes, log rotation, and configuration parameter management.

methods.name: send_signal_to_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Sends a specified signal to a prplMesh process by name.

methods.name: start_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Starts a prplMesh process by name.

methods.name: stop_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Stops a prplMesh process by name, with a timeout and fallback to kill signal.

methods.name: roll_logs_function
methods.description: Handles log rotation for prplMesh logs by signaling processes and managing log files.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: odl_get_str_param
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from ODL configuration files.

methods.name: odl_set_param
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in ODL configuration files.

methods.name: ensure_platform_db
methods.description: Ensures the platform database file exists in /tmp/beerocks.

methods.name: certification_mode_to_num
methods.description: Converts various certification mode descriptors to numeric representation.

methods.name: set_management_and_certification_mode
methods.description: Sets management and certification modes in configuration.

methods.name: start_func
methods.description: Starts all necessary prplMesh processes based on current configuration.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that parses command-line arguments and executes commands accordingly.
